name: Cash payments to informal suppliers or ground-level operators
description: Large or repeated cash payments to informal traders, producers or workers in extraction or supply chains.
fp: Informal markets often transact in cash.

links.name: Cash payments to local loggers and chain-saw operators
links.ctx: Large cash withdrawals followed by purchases of raw logs from informal suppliers.
links.fp: Informal logging is lawful in some community forestry.

links.name: Large cash purchases from informal miners and traders
links.ctx: Dealer pays cash at remote sites and deposits to bank accounts mixed with legitimate sales.
links.fp: Artisanal mining economies are cash based.

links.name: Cash payments to landowners or drivers for dumping
links.ctx: Payments to farmers, quarry owners or drivers for tipping.

links.name: Cash intensive purchases by wholesalers at auctions or farms
links.ctx: Large cash buys from breeders, farms or auctions, then export.
links.fp: Farms are cash-heavy in some regions.
